title: Full GUI release with desktop installers
highlights: IDEOCODE GUI desktop installers now ship on all platforms: Windows (NSIS + MSI), macOS (DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel), and Linux (AppImage).
CI pipeline fully fixed: build-gui job now builds, packages, and publishes GUI installers alongside TUI binaries on every release.
SHA256SUMS now covers all release assets including .msi, .dmg, .AppImage, and .deb formats.
improvements: Switched GUI CI from npm to pnpm to support workspace protocol dependencies.
Increased Tauri build timeout to 120 minutes for full Rust workspace compilation.
Added binary existence verification before packaging to fail fast on build errors.
Fixed packaging step to use root workspace target/ directory (cargo workspace member behavior).
fixes: Fixed build-gui CI job: replaced npm with pnpm and added pnpm/action-setup step.
Fixed package step path: cargo uses root target/ when src-tauri is a workspace member.
Added error output on packaging failure for easier CI debugging.
